theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fc_eu_cutoff_mass_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = X → Y.support ⊆ K → Y.mass ≤ X.mass ∧ Y.boundary.mass ≤ X.boundary.mass
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
